skill_name: Describe the 5 most common financial crimes
workflow: The five most common financial crimes are fraud, embezzlement, money laundering, identity theft, and cybercrime. Fraud is the intentional deception of individuals or entities to obtain money or property unlawfully. Embezzlement is the illegal use of assets by an individual or entity entrusted with the assets.
